name: Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Tunnel
facts: On 2 April 2017, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 9.28‑km Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Tunnel, India's longest road tunnel, cutting Jammu‑Srinagar distance by 30 km and saving two hours of travel.

The tunnel’s two parallel tubes—13 m main and 6 m escape—feature 29 cross passages every 300 m, 124 cameras, and a transverse ventilation system that makes it the world’s sixth road tunnel with such a system.
Built at 1,200 m altitude, the Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Tunnel bypasses 44 avalanche‑prone spots, enabling all‑weather travel and boosting trade and tourism in Jammu and Kashmir.
